data.one_liner: Custom border implementation for dashed lines and curves in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom border implementation for rendering dashed lines, curves, and corner-only borders in Flutter widgets. Supports different colors, widths, and border radii per side.
use_when: You need containers or widgets with dashed borders.
You want to customize dash length, spacing, and corner styling.
avoid_when: You only need standard solid borders provided by Flutter's default BoxBorder.
strengths: Supports rounded corners with dashed borders
Allows different colors and widths per side
Supports drawing borders only on corners
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic usage samples
